killedBy: focusableControls: the branch no panel can reach (issue #556) excludes a negative tabindex, and keeps the controls either side of it
why: Lets an element that is deliberately out of the sequential focus order into the roving order. This is the one branch of `focusable.ts` that NO `createHud` test can reach, because nothing in the HUD carries a negative `tabindex` -- the line's own comment says so. Measured before the module test was written: every other branch of this file is killed by the existing panel tests (ancestors 3 cases, disabled 2, hidden 8, the capture no-op 1, the same-row fallback 1), and this one survived the whole suite. It is also why the move out of `createHud` is worth something beyond file size: the guard could not be exercised at all while it was reachable only by building a panel that contains the attribute, and no panel does.
